text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out together, I accompany
Special
Week back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today. I had lots
of fun
hanging out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But Trainer, I don't wanna go home just
yet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm so relaxed, I feel like I can
really
focus on my training.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So could I ask you to tag along with me
for a little
while longer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Okay, what should we do now? I'm ready
for
whatever, so let me have it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see! That's the kind of training to do
when I'm
really focused!
choice_data_list: コーナリングのコツを掴もう
choice_data_list_en: Let's get the hang of the finishing kick.
Let's get the hang of cornering.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty! I'm gonna crush this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day out has given Special Week
more
motivation than usual to focus on
her training,
and she masters her
finishing dashes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see. This is gonna be more difficult
than I
thought, so it's probably best to
take it on while
I've got the energy for
it!
